title: SurfaceResponse
description: Authored localized damp response on a continuous mineral finish, shared by create parameters and variant metadata.

coverage.description: Maximum affected texel fraction, including smooth transitions; rounded down to whole texels. About 40 percent of this support is fully damp.

patchScale.description: Broad mask lattice spacing in metres, rounded to whole periods per tile; each tile axis must cover at least two spacings.

roughness.description: Absolute roughness in the fully damp core; transitions approach the dry response.

darkening.description: Fractional basecolor darkening in the fully damp core.

reliefRetention.description: Fraction of dry relief retained in the fully damp core.
